answer.rationale: The mandate and incumbent's refusal to reopen price leave switching as the only path meeting the 18% cut this cycle, and the contract's non-auto-renewal forces action within 14 days. However, memory_c2's claim of quick, accurate onboarding is a year old and unverified against current conditions; with the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, any onboarding friction directly risks missed deliveries. I verify c2's archived record to check whether onboarding speed/accuracy claims included any caveats about ramp-up risk or volume constraints that were omitted in consolidation. Given the tight capacity buffer, I favor a guarded transition (parallel/phased cutover) rather than an abrupt full switch, to contain delivery risk while still capturing the cost benefit this cycle.
